_comment: The website's original wording, which Kerimah can change on the Site text page in the admin. Her edits are kept in the database (site_text table); this file is the original that "Reset to original" goes back to. The site's code reads it too, so a page shows this text if the API is slow. kind: line (one line), text (line breaks kept; an empty line starts a new paragraph), list (one item per line), pairs (questions and answers). {deposit} is filled in with the deposit from Settings.

blocks.label: Bio
blocks.help: Leave an empty line between paragraphs. The Home page shows the first paragraph.
blocks.default:
My learning experience into holistic health started in 2011, earning credentials from The Salter School & The Costa Rica School of Massage Therapy. Licensed by the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, I am certified in reflexology and insured through Associated Bodywork & Massage Professionals.

My great-grandfather was a massage therapist in Panama, and I am grateful to continue his journey through his talents. As an earth sign, my healing element is water. I enjoy good food, creative writing, sunrises, and swimming.
